rule_name: Minimum Evidence Payload for Legitimate Proposition Synthesis

required_elements.name: evidence_anchor
required_elements.description: Pointer to the experiment/node/tool run that produced the evidence

required_elements.name: empirical_artifacts
required_elements.description: At least one numeric or structural artifact traceable to panel/tool computation

required_elements.name: structural_context
required_elements.description: Population/outcome/horizon/feature slice under which evidence was observed

required_elements.name: surprise_basis
required_elements.description: Recorded comparison or threshold that makes evidence non-trivial
examples: shape gradient detected with sufficient sample
conflict with prior experiment on same core

optional_index.obs_codes: May list OBS_* for audit cross-reference only
optional_index.gap_codes: May list GAP_* for audit cross-reference only — never sole justification

provenance_integrity_checks: empirical_artifacts must be reproducible from cited experiment_node_id + tool replay
structural_context must match experiment scope at time of observation
surprise_basis must cite empirical comparison not template name
no hidden_benchmark_phenomenon_id in provenance chain during generator development
reject_if: empirical_artifacts empty or purely categorical without numeric backing
surprise_basis references template_id or GAP name without empirical delta
provenance experiment_node_id not in research graph lineage
